item.title: Daily digest — 2026-08-03
item.description:
It's been an exciting week in our open-source research community, with multiple projects seeing significant updates. The `tenzing` project, led by marton-balazs-kovacs, released version 0.4.1, which was quickly deployed to the `gh-pages` branch by Anka. Meanwhile, the `scrutiny` project, led by lhdjung, saw updates to its CITATION.cff file and not one, but two deployments to the `gh-pages` branch, indicating a busy release cycle. Over in the `oddpub` project, the ontogenerator was updated to include new detection capabilities, showcasing the community's ongoing commitment to innovation. These updates demonstrate the connections and progress being made across our projects, and we celebrate the hard work of contributors like Alex O. Holcombe, Lukas Jung, and the entire community. As our projects continue to evolve, we look forward to seeing the impact of these updates on the broader research landscape.

30 commits across 5 active repositories this week.

New releases: auto-zcurve v0.11.1

Dormant repos revived: scrutiny, escicheck

Most active:

coarse14 commits
auto-zcurve8 commits
scrutiny4 commits
metacheck3 commits

item.title: scrutiny: activity update
item.description:
lhdjung/scrutiny

The `gh-pages` branch was deployed to twice, first from commit `a81cd540332cf402c1ffc798f93534c31da17009` and then from commit `0fd47d0e2ffee48a24c1806c4e4bcd2da5d4e238`, with the message "Deploying to gh-pages" accompanying both deployments. Both deployments were marked with a rocket ship emoji, indicating a release or deployment, as noted by the messages "Deploying to gh-pages from @ lhdjung/scrutiny@a81cd540332cf402c1ffc798f93534c31da17009 🚀" and "Deploying to gh-pages from @ lhdjung/scrutiny@0fd47d0e2ffee48a24c1806c4e4bcd2da5d4e238 🚀". The `main` and `gh-pages` branches were the only two branches worked on in this set of commits.
